prompts.title: Trending Doodle Shadow
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded character reference image as the strict identity and outfit reference. Preserve the reference character’s face identity, facial proportions, eye shape, nose, lips, skin tone, hairstyle, hair color, visible accessories, overall recognizable vibe, outfit and styling shown in the reference image

Do not hardcode any specific character traits that are not present in the uploaded reference.
All identity, hairstyle, accessories, and clothing details must be inferred directly from the uploaded reference image.

Create a high-quality mixed-style vertical portrait showing:
1. a realistic full-body version of the uploaded character/person
2. a black hand-drawn doodle-shadow version of the same character/person on the wall beside them

Core concept:
The real person and their doodle-shadow are doing a playful mischievous pose together.
The real person performs a cute realistic version of the pose, while the doodle-shadow performs a much more exaggerated, chaotic, cartoonish version of the same pose idea.
The mood should feel cute, playful, mischievous, stylish, funny, and social-media-friendly.

Real person:
- Must remain realistic and photogenic
- Must wear the same outfit style and key visible details from the uploaded reference image
- Do not replace the reference styling with unrelated fashion
- Expression should be cute, slightly confused, mildly embarrassed, playful, as if thinking: “Why am I doing this with my shadow?”
- The real person should not stand stiffly
- The real person should actively participate in the pose, but in a natural realistic way

Doodle-shadow:
- Must be a black hand-drawn sketch version of the same person, drawn directly on the wall
- Not a realistic second person
- Not a normal physical shadow
- Not a full-color anime character
- Black sketch line-art only
- Should resemble the person through hairstyle silhouette, accessories, outfit silhouette, and pose structure
- The doodle-shadow should look more energetic, sillier, and more chaotic than the real person
- Add manga-like motion lines, hearts, stars, sparkles, and comic marks around the doodle if helpful

Random mischievous pose rule:
The pose must NOT be fixed.
For each generation, invent a new playful mischievous pose for both the real person and the doodle-shadow.
The real person and the doodle-shadow should share the same general pose idea, but they do not need to match perfectly.
The real person performs a cute realistic version.
The doodle-shadow performs a much more exaggerated, chaotic, cartoonish version.

Do not repeatedly use pointing poses.
Do not repeatedly use finger-gun poses.
Do not repeatedly use the same standing pose.
Do not always make both figures simply point at each other.

Create a different mischievous pose each time.

Possible pose directions are loose inspiration only, not a fixed menu:
- playful idol pose
- silly dance pose
- leaning sideways with one arm curved overhead
- making a big heart pose
- cheeky wink pose
- hands near cheeks in a cute teasing pose
- exaggerated “that's it!” pose
- mock surprise pose
- playful running-in-place pose
- mischievous tiptoe pose
- arms stretched in opposite directions
- pretending to sneak away
- cute troublemaker pose
- dramatic overreaction pose
- goofy victory pose
- playful balance pose
- playful peekaboo pose
- shy but mischievous pose
- cute overconfident pose

The final pose should feel fresh, cute, mischievous, and slightly chaotic.
The real person should look like they are reluctantly playing along.
The doodle-shadow should look like it is having way too much fun.

Composition:
- vertical 3:4 or 2:3
- show the real person in full-body or nearly full-body framing
- place the real person on one side of the frame
- place the black doodle-shadow on a clean wall beside them
- the doodle-shadow should be roughly the same height or slightly taller
- keep enough space around both figures so the full pose is visible
- the connection between the real person and the doodle-shadow must be clear at a glance

Background:
- simple clean indoor studio wall or minimal room corner
- white, cream, or pale gray wall
- clean floor
- soft natural sunlight patch or gentle wall shadow allowed
- keep the background uncluttered

Lighting:
- soft natural studio lighting
- bright, clean, polished, playful mood
- keep the real person’s face clearly visible

Style quality:
- realistic human photography
- black hand-drawn doodle-shadow on wall
- matching mischievous pose interaction
- strong identity resemblance
- outfit and styling faithfully based on the uploaded reference
- cute and stylish mixed-media portrait
- clean composition
- social-media-friendly
- no obvious AI artifacts

Negative prompt:
Outfit change unrelated to reference, realistic second person, normal reflection, normal shadow only, solid black monster shadow, horror shadow, creepy shadow, full-color illustration, cartoon human, anime human, weak resemblance, unrelated sketch character, messy wall, cluttered background, repeated pointing pose, repeated finger-gun pose, same pose every time, fixed pose, boring mirrored pose, stiff pose, identical pose repetition, real person not matching shadow pose, text, watermark, logo, distorted body, extra limbs, extra fingers, bad hands.

Composition & Camera:
Vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. Eye-level cinematic camera angle. The subject emerging from the sketchbook should occupy roughly 65–75% of the frame. Keep the face, hands, torn paper, pencil, and spiral binding clearly visible. Use shallow depth of field: sharp focus on the man, torn paper, graphite portrait, and foreground pencil interaction, with background art supplies softly blurred. Maintain a balanced composition with strong visual depth and no awkward cropping.
Atmosphere & Style:
The image should feel like a magical realism moment frozen between imagination and reality, where fine-art pencil drawing transforms into a living person. The final result must be cinematic, immersive, dramatic, premium, and visually striking, combining photorealistic 3D rendering with realistic graphite illustration details.
Quality:
Ultra-detailed, photorealistic textures, realistic anatomy, cinematic color grading, high dynamic range, crisp focus, studio-quality rendering, 8K-level detail, professional fantasy editorial artwork.
Negative Instructions:
Do not change the subject’s identity. Do not make the expression angry, sad, scary, or overly dramatic. Do not crop the face or hands. Do not hide the spiral binding. Do not make the paper tear look flat. Do not make the pencil hand too large or unnatural. Do not add extra text, logos, watermarks, random symbols, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, or cartoonish effects.

prompts.title: A Stoic Profile
prompts.prompt:
Create an 8k ultra-high-resolution mixed-media portrait illustration that blends photorealistic character rendering with expressive watercolor and architectural sketch techniques.
Face Matching & Identity Accuracy:
Match the face and identity with high accuracy from the provided reference image.
Subject & Expression:
Subject is very confident. His facial features are sharp and realistic with detailed skin texture and defined cheekbones. His expression is serious, focused, and contemplative, with a subtle furrow in his brow. His gaze looks upward and off-camera, suggesting determination and forward vision.
Pose:
Chest-up portrait. The torso is angled slightly toward the viewer’s left while the head turns upward toward the right side of the frame. This twist in the shoulders and neck creates a dynamic, heroic stance.
Outfit:
A dark charcoal-black short-sleeve polo shirt with a ribbed collar and a two-button placket. The shirt is rendered with painterly shading and sketch-style cross-hatching that gradually dissolves into watercolor textures toward the lower part of the portrait.
Composition & Camera Angle:
Medium close-up (chest-up). Slight low-angle “hero shot” perspective that emphasizes the jawline and gives the subject a powerful presence. The subject is placed slightly off-center, leaving negative space around the head and shoulders.
Lighting:
Dramatic directional lighting from the upper left side. The light highlights the forehead, nose bridge, and cheekbones while casting deeper shadow along the opposite side of the face and neck, creating strong contrast and depth.
Background & Artistic Style:
Clean white background with no physical environment. Behind the subject are expressive orange watercolor splashes, ink drips, and paint blooms forming an energetic halo. Thin architectural pencil construction lines and sketch marks intersect across the composition, adding structure and motion.
Artistic Medium & Texture:
A hybrid style combining photorealistic digital painting, loose watercolor washes, ink splatter effects, and raw sketch linework. The face remains highly detailed and realistic while the shoulders and lower areas transition into unfinished painterly strokes and abstract watercolor textures.
Color Palette:
Natural warm skin tones contrasted with a dark black shirt and vibrant watercolor hues of burnt orange, amber, and sienna against a bright white canvas.
Technical Details:
Ultra-detailed digital illustration, 8K resolution, sharp facial focus, painterly brush textures, watercolor bloom effects, ink splashes, architectural sketch lines, soft fade-out edges.
Aspect ratio 4:5

prompts.title: Cozy 3D Family Gathering
prompts.prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 full-body family portrait in a premium high-quality stylized 3D animated illustration style. Use the uploaded family photo as the subject reference and keep each person clearly recognizable through their facial structure, hairstyle, glasses if present, age feel, and natural expression, while converting them into a polished cute 3D animated look. The rendering should feel rich, detailed, soft, and high-end, with natural skin shading, detailed hair strands, realistic fabric texture, and smooth cinematic polish. Avoid any plastic, waxy, toy-like, or cheap CGI appearance.
Camera Angle & Framing — Strict:

Use a clearly elevated high-angle camera view, as if the camera is positioned above the family and tilted downward toward them, not at eye level. This perspective must create the same playful visual effect as the reference: faces and upper bodies appear slightly larger, the floor and rug are visibly seen beneath them, and the full bodies taper naturally toward the feet. Keep the family large in the frame, filling most of the composition from top to bottom. Show everyone head to toe, but avoid loose framing, excess empty wall, or a front-facing formal portrait look.
Family Placement & Pose:

This prompt should work for any number of family members. Arrange them in a tight, affectionate cluster with a warm, joyful, close-family feel. If children are present, place them toward the center/front of the group, not pushed to the side. Adults should stand slightly behind or around them, with natural affectionate gestures such as arms resting around shoulders, backs, or waists. Everyone should look directly toward the camera with bright, genuine, happy smiles. The pose should feel lively, loving, and candid, not stiff, symmetrical, or studio-formal.
Character Design:

Use a cute premium animated character style with slightly oversized expressive eyes, softly rounded facial forms, fuller charming head proportions, rich voluminous hair, and lively joyful facial emotion. Keep the characters adorable and expressive, but still refined and elegant. Do not make them too realistic, flat, generic, or proportioned like ordinary humans in a simple front-facing poster.
Outfits:

Keep the outfit vibe connected to the input, but when clothing is too plain, refine it into modern, clean, stylish family-casual fashion similar to the reference image. Use tasteful pieces such as soft cardigans, knit sweaters, neat blouses, denim jackets, striped inner tops, fitted trousers, loafers, simple sneakers, or other contemporary everyday outfits. The clothing should look polished, age-appropriate, and visually coordinated without feeling overstyled.
Background & Doodles:

Place the family in a clean cozy indoor setting with a warm beige wall, light wooden floor, a simple cream rug with brown geometric border patterns, and a small softly blurred potted plant in one corner. Keep the room minimal and uncluttered. Around the family, add playful hand-drawn wall doodles using bold dark-brown linework with a few warm colored accents, including pink or red hearts, yellow stars, sparkle marks, small celebratory doodles, and a tiny sketched family drawing. Add clear handwritten speech bubbles such as “Yay!” and “Family!”, arranged around the subjects without covering any faces or bodies.
Color & Lighting:

Use rich, warm, cheerful colors like the reference image, not washed-out or dull tones. The scene should feel bright, cozy, inviting, and emotionally warm, with balanced accents of beige, cream, pink, denim blue, warm brown, black, and soft red/yellow doodle highlights. Use soft warm indoor lighting with gentle face highlights, natural shadows under the feet, subtle edge separation, and a polished premium finish.
Strict Result Goal:

The final image should closely follow the top-down camera angle, tight frame-filling composition, cute premium 3D proportions, rich warm color palette, playful doodle wall, minimal cozy background, and affectionate family energy, while preserving the uploaded family members’ recognizable identities and arrangement.

prompts.title: Monarch Muse
prompts.prompt:
Create a 2:3 vertical premium mixed-media watercolor portrait on off-white cold-pressed watercolor paper.
Use the uploaded image only as the subject reference. Keep the subject’s natural features, overall appearance, and recognizable look intact, but do not let the image turn into a generic painted character.
Show the subject in a bust-length three-quarter profile, facing slightly toward the viewer’s right, with the gaze directed softly off-camera. Keep the expression calm, warm, serene, and naturally pleasant, with a subtle gentle smile and bright relaxed eyes. The mood should feel elegant, fresh, dreamy, and refined — not sad, blank, tired, or overly serious.
Keep the face highly realistic and softly photorealistic, not fully painted, not sketch-like, and not cartoonish. The face should be the main focal point. Use soft diffused natural-looking light, similar to indirect window light, to gently illuminate the forehead, nose bridge, cheeks, lips, and jawline, with delicate depth and soft shadows. Render realistic eyes with soft catchlights, defined brows, natural lips, smooth skin transitions, and fine hair strands.
Style the hair in an elegant loose low updo / low messy bun at the nape, with a few soft tendrils framing the face and neck. Intertwine subtle rustic botanical accents in the hair — tiny dried wildflowers in muted yellow, white, and blue tones — delicate, understated, and premium.
Add several detailed Monarch butterflies with vivid orange wings, black veins, black borders, and tiny white spots. Keep them crisp, refined, and slightly dimensional. Place multiple butterflies naturally around the portrait: some resting in the hair, one near the upper-right side, and others floating around the shoulders and lower frame. Their warm orange color should stand out beautifully against the cool watercolor tones.
Create a strong mixed-media double-exposure effect where parts of the portrait dissolve into watercolor blooms. This effect must be clearly visible across selected parts of the cheek, temple, jawline, neck, shoulder, and lower clothing area — not only in the background. The watercolor should feel translucent and layered over the realistic portrait, so the subject remains clearly realistic underneath.
Use expressive watercolor washes in muted teal, seafoam green, dusty blue, soft gray, charcoal, and deep navy tones. Let the washes bloom naturally into the paper with wet-on-wet behavior, soft transparent bleeding, irregular edges, subtle blooms, and a few darker pooled edges where pigment appears to have dried. Allow the watercolor to expand organically into the negative space while keeping the face as the sharpest and most detailed focal area.
Dress the subject in a simple deep navy-blue top / blouse with a high rounded neckline and soft gathered or finely pleated texture around the shoulders and upper chest. The garment should look minimal, elegant, matte, and plain, with no collar, no buttons, no printed pattern, and no decorative embellishments. Keep the outfit close to the reference look. Let the lower portion of the top gradually dissolve into blue-gray watercolor splashes.
Preserve the contrast between hyper-detailed realism and loose abstract watercolor forms. The final artwork should feel like a luxury fine-art portrait print that combines:

photorealistic portraiture
abstract watercolor fusion
soft ethereal surrealism
crisp butterfly detailing
cool watercolor tones contrasted with vivid orange butterflies
textured watercolor paper and handcrafted mixed-media realism
Overall, the result should feel poetic, airy, elegant, and premium, with the viewer’s eye drawn first to the realistic face, then to the translucent watercolor overlays and butterflies surrounding the subject.

prompts.prompt:

Subject & Outfit:
The subject is seated on a minimal metal folding chair, wearing an oversized tailored black blazer layered over a clean black shirt, paired with relaxed black trousers and chunky white-colored sneakers. Accessories include sleek dark sunglasses and a subtle minimal chain necklace. The outfit must appear crisp, structured, and completely wrinkle-free with clearly visible fabric texture and sharp detailing.
Pose & Expression:
Relaxed yet confident seated pose. One arm (right arm) is resting comfortably over the backrest of the chair, with the hand hanging naturally, while the other arm rests loosely on his thigh.
Legs are spread naturally, not overly wide, maintaining a balanced and grounded stance. Adding depth and a subtle dynamic to the pose. Calm, self-assured expression with a composed gaze directed toward the camera.
Composition & Framing (STRICT):
Full-body composition, subject centered with balanced negative space. A polished editorial look. No cropping of head or feet.

Soft professional studio lighting with gentle directional shadows falling subtly toward the right side of the floor. Even exposure across face and outfit — no harsh shadows or underexposure. Clean tonal contrast in monochrome.
Background:
Seamless pure white studio background with a soft gradient falloff, maintaining a clean minimalist aesthetic.
Graphic Elements (Doodles):
Surrounding the subject are bold, hand-drawn graffiti-style doodles in black, white, and vibrant orange accents. Elements include lightning bolts, arrows, stars, swirls, and abstract strokes. Integrated motivational text in a hand-drawn style:

Doodles must be arranged in a visually balanced, symmetrical composition around the subject and must not cover or fill the entire background.
The doodles should feel energetic and dynamic while framing the subject without overlapping the face. Bright orange accents should pop against the monochrome scene.

Ultra-sharp focus, cinematic contrast, editorial fashion aesthetic, 8K resolution, high detail retention, clean monochrome subject with vibrant graphic highlights.

prompts.title: Sketch & Splatter
prompts.prompt:
Create an expressive, high-end artistic portrait of a person looking slightly upward and off to one side, capturing a sense of curiosity, wonder, and thoughtful imagination. The gaze is directed just above the frame, with wide, reflective eyes and a subtle emotional intensity.
The subject wears oversized, bold orange eyeglasses with a slightly translucent frame. The lenses have a soft warm tint that gently diffuses light and creates natural reflections without obscuring the eyes.
The face is illustrated in a semi-realistic style using dynamic black ink sketch lines combined with painterly color work. Linework should be loose yet controlled, with visible strokes, cross-hatching, and contour lines that enhance depth and structure. Skin rendering should feel organic and textured, not smooth or plastic — maintaining a balance between realism and expressive illustration.
Hair is styled in a slightly messy, voluminous updo with natural strands and sketch lines extending outward, blending into the surrounding paint splashes for a cohesive artistic flow.
The background is a layered collage of vintage newspaper textures, partially visible and abstracted into the composition. Text must not be sharp or readable — only used as a subtle graphic texture integrated with the artwork.
Add energetic paint splashes and ink bursts in vivid blue, orange, and hints of yellow around the head, radiating outward. These splashes should feel spontaneous, layered, and physically interacting with the portrait — some overlapping hair and edges to create depth and motion.
Lighting is soft yet directional, coming from slightly above and to one side, enhancing facial structure and creating gentle highlights on the glasses, nose bridge, and cheekbones. Shadows should be painterly and blended, not harsh.
Composition is a clean head-and-neck portrait. The framing includes the full head and neck with slight breathing space around the hair. No clothing details should distract — only minimal suggestion of the neckline. Maintain balanced negative space while allowing paint splashes to break the boundary naturally.
Style blends editorial illustration, ink sketch art, and abstract expressionism. High contrast, rich saturation, textured brushwork, and fine-art quality.
Ultra-detailed, sharp focus, visible brush textures, natural skin tones.
No text, no watermark, no logos.

prompts.title: Life in Panels
prompts.prompt:
Create a striking mixed-media composition featuring a high-resolution photographic portrait of a reference man standing in front of a large, wall-sized black-and-white manga collage. The image should visually represent the “multifaceted” or “multiverse” nature of the subject’s personality.

Framing & Scale: Subject occupies approximately 60–80% of the frame height, positioned perfectly centered in a vertical 2:3 composition

Expression: Natural smile or calm confidence

Pose: Standing in the center foreground with a relaxed posture, hands casually in pockets, legs slightly crossed at the ankles

Attire (Adaptive): Modern casual outfit (e.g., denim jacket or minimalist jacket over a plain white t-shirt, paired with fitted jeans or trousers, clean footwear). Keep styling contemporary, clean, and realistic

Lighting: Bright, professional studio lighting with soft shadows, ensuring strong subject-background separation and a crisp, high-end photographic look

Background (Manga Collage World)

Style: Classic Japanese manga aesthetic — bold black ink lines, screentone textures (halftone dots), high contrast, and dynamic speed lines

Color: Strictly black-and-white manga style (no color in background)

Narrative Panels (Same Subject as Manga Character)

The background collage features multiple manga panels depicting alternate versions of the same man in different life scenarios:

Riding a motorcycle with dynamic speed lines and “VROOM” text

Focused and working at a desk or computer setup

Walking through a busy urban street scene

Using a smartphone or camera (vlogging/selfie perspective)

Laughing or interacting with friends, expressive and social

Enjoying time with family (He with his partner and two children)

Include a mix of Japanese onomatopoeia (e.g., ドキドキ, バン) and English sound effects integrated naturally into panels.

Composition & Contrast

Strong visual contrast between:

Foreground: ultra-realistic, high-detail photographic subject

Background: flat, stylized, monochrome manga world

Seamless depth separation — subject should “pop” clearly from the background

Environment & Final Details

Clean white floor with subtle shadow grounding the subject

Balanced composition with cinematic depth

Mood: modern, empowered, dynamic, and aspirational — representing ambition, creativity, and social energy

Strictly maintain high-fidelity facial structure and exact likeness from the reference image. Integrate the face naturally with the scene's lighting. Ensure realistic skin texture with visible pores and minor imperfections; absolutely avoid overly smooth AI skin or a pasted face-swap look.
